camel_example: aliyun live ModifyLiveMessageGroupBand --region cn-hangzhou --AppId demo --GroupId grouptest
description_en: Changes the mute status of users in a group
kebab_example: aliyun live modify-live-message-group-band --app-id demo --group-id grouptest --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyLiveMessageGroupBand

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to mute all users in the group
parameters.name: banned_all

parameters.help_en: The list of users to mute. You can specify up to 30 users. Separate multiple user IDs with a comma (,)
parameters.help_zh: 被禁言的用户列表。多个用半角逗号（,）隔开，最多不超过30个
parameters.name: bannned_users

parameters.help_en: The list of users who are not muted when all users in the group are muted. You can specify up to 30 users. Separate multiple user IDs with a comma (,)
parameters.help_zh: 当开启全员禁言时不被禁言的用户列表。多个用半角逗号（,）隔开，最多不超过30个
parameters.name: except_users

parameters.help_en: The data center. This must be the same data center specified in the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848162.html call. Valid values: \`cn-shanghai\` (Shanghai) and \`ap-southeast-1\` (Singapore)
parameters.help_zh: 数据中心，需要与https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848162.html中的数据中心一致，当前支持上海（取值为cn-shanghai)、新加坡（取值为ap-southeast-1）
parameters.name: data_center
